headline: Solar Canopies Over Crops Generate Power While Protecting Plants
meta_description: Solar canopies suspended 5 meters above cornfields produce clean energy while shielding crops from extreme heat and reducing water loss.
summary_short: Solar canopies mounted 5 meters above corn fields are generating renewable energy while protecting crops from heat stress and water loss.
body:
Solar canopies suspended 5 meters above a corn field are simultaneously producing clean energy and protecting crops from extreme heat—a dual-benefit approach addressing two critical challenges at once.

The elevated canopies shield the plants below from the worst effects of intense heat while reducing evapotranspiration, the process by which water is lost from soil and plants into the atmosphere. By limiting this water loss, the system helps boost overall crop yield.

The innovation demonstrates how renewable energy infrastructure can do more than generate power. Rather than competing with agriculture for land, these structures work in tandem with farming, offering farmers both environmental and economic benefits by improving crop resilience while contributing clean energy to the grid.
quick_facts: Solar canopies positioned 5 meters above cornfields
Produces clean energy while protecting crops
Shields plants from extreme heat damage
Reduces evapotranspiration and boosts crop yield
